purpose: Register the already-created E1/E3/E4 Alpha Lab execution packet under existing prospective-evidence governance without creating a scanner, scorer, ledger engine, or trading authority.

E1.question: Do first-party disclosed 0x addresses frozen before T0 match receipt.from/deployer on future eligible Pons launches at a rate that survives prospective falsification?
E1.historical_seed_note: STIMMY is context only and can never count toward prospective confirmation.
E1.promotion_condition: At least two additional independently eligible prospective confirmations plus separate red-team/governance review.
E1.kill_condition: Any cohort-selection or lineage breach kills affected evidence; preregistration must also freeze a max-window end and no extension is allowed merely because confirmations are absent.

E3.question: Does a genuinely pre-frozen first-party CA-publication surface publish early enough relative to canonical T0 to support a useful verified-before-public edge?
E3.promotion_condition: No automatic promotion. Separate review only after >=30 eligible rows and complete coverage.
E3.kill_condition: At >=30 eligible rows, if median delta_publish is worse than the frozen external-edge budget, VERIFIED-before-public is killed or re-scoped to candidate-grade research. No post-hoc surface substitution.

E4.question: Does frozen dev-buy size show fresh out-of-sample lift over an independently reproduced eligible-launch denominator?
E4.promotion_condition: Fresh OOS lift >=1.5x with uncertainty reported, adequate coverage, no material data-health defect, and separate governance review.
E4.kill_condition: Discovery-sample lift cannot count. Any denominator mismatch, outcome leakage, material coverage defect, or inability to independently reproduce the denominator blocks or kills the affected run.

E2_hold.rule: Do not build a wallet sensor. Only a separately demonstrated independent wallet effect may justify a future proposal.
